text.en:
The Central Bank of the Philippines is hereby authorized to operate a security printing plant for
the printing of bank notes, as well as to undertake such other security printing work as the facilities of the
plant would permit.

All acts, laws, executive orders, rules and regulations, or parts thereof, inconsistent with any of
the provisions of this Decree are repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 18th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-four.
